tasks.short: Prepare departmental budgets, purchases and work schedules

steps.what: Gather departmental service needs, supply requirements and staffing constraints
Calculate the departmental operating budget from checked planning assumptions
Prepare purchase requests for supplies or equipment
Prepare work schedules using checked availability and coverage requirements
Review budget, purchasing and schedule trade-offs and coordinate authorised next steps

tasks.design: Configure checked budget formulas in {SPREADSHEET}, saved purchasing fields in {PROCUREMENT} and reusable schedule views in {HCM}. The technologist retains input capture, staffing choices and all trade-off review; authorised managers keep budget approval, supplier commitments and schedule publication.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated calculation and copying after the planning assumptions were gathered.
tasks.enabler_now: Native formulas, purchasing forms and schedule views can reuse checked fields.
tasks.still_hard: Safe coverage and service needs cannot be reduced to cost or throughput targets.
tasks.human_edge: Challenge a financially tidy plan that lacks safe clinical capacity.
tasks.altitude: Less preparation across supervisory duties; no new spending or staffing authority.

reach.task: Resolve a budget or staffing gap before plan approval
reach.learn: Cost assumptions, competence coverage and delegation limits

evidence.claim: Native budget formulas, purchasing forms and schedule templates can reduce repetitive preparation; no clinical decision automation or measured labour saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is the technologist's supervisory preparation, not finance bookkeeping, supplier fulfilment, staff work or management approval. The shares describe a recurring mix of budgets, purchases and schedules, not mandatory outputs every day. Keep period work schedules separate from live patient-flow duty assignment in team roll-up.

Technologist produces checked inputs in s1: planning period, cost code, quantity, unit rate, supply item, required date, coverage need and known staff constraints. Full gathering and capture time remains. Finance supplies existing cost reports, HR supplies current roster and qualifications, and service owners supply the service plan through unchanged processes; {OTHER} is the radiology information system.

Supplier quotations are existing supplier-produced documents, captured and checked in retained s3 time. Native formulas use checked quantities and rates only. Missing budget fields use manual calculation in s2; uncertain purchasing details are clarified in s3; missing availability or competence information is clarified in s4. No missing field is guessed.
Test native configuration before custom code. Schedule choices remain manual in retained s4 time; no staff ranking, autonomous purchase or plan publication. Existing system runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Delegated supervisory duties and approval ownership
Native form coverage and repeat-entry baseline
research_questions: Do native preparation features save time after input capture, manual staffing choices and exception checks?

already_counted.description: Check budget formulas and incomplete cost inputs
Capture quotation details and review purchase exceptions
Choose schedule entries and check coverage exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain formulas, purchasing fields and schedule templates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=74.5; gross 25.5 less upkeep 4 gives net 21.5. High assumes recurring budgets, standard forms and reusable schedule layouts; low assumes unusual equipment requests and coverage changes consume gains. Input gathering and final coordination retain 50 hours.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The technologist retains clinical capacity judgement and supervisory coordination while reducing repeated preparation.
reach: Help department managers and finance colleagues resolve safe-capacity and budget gaps
role.ambitious_version: Prepare realistic departmental plans with traceable inputs and clear human authority.
